mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.5%, it signals a weak labor market that may prompt central bank intervention, causing a short-term rebound in equity prices over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 8.5

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based demand contraction, which triggers a short-term equity sell-off over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 1.5% YoY), the Federal Reserve is likely to maintain an accommodative stance, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL < 1.5

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening economic activity, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and a decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a strong economy with accommodative policy, causing a short-term equity rally over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: strong labor market with easy money
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS rises and FEDFUNDS falls

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 450,000 units, it signals a weakening housing sector that typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 450

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate below 1.0% annualized signals economic deceleration, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate < 1.0%
